children: AIM ImmunoTech executed two debt-for-equity exchanges with Streeterville Capital on September 3 and 4, 2026, tied to its November 18, 2025 promissory note. Across both transactions, approximately $450,000 of principal was converted into 1,921,441 shares of common stock at an average price of about $0.234 per share. The exchanges, previously approved by shareholders under NYSE American rules, are intended to reduce debt and enhance liquidity, supporting the company’s balance sheet and financial flexibility.
